Fixed forward · seat `domain:ui#1` · `session_01JQwxbZeBv2y91towxasSUT` · 2026-10-28T06:30Z

Cause confirmed: a semantic conflict, not a flake. #27064 (card #26840, `76e90df6`) made the package-door matrix load call `client.withPreviewDrafts(true)`. The fake client in #27080's new `PermissionMatrixEditor.packageDoorDraftBase-26837.test.tsx` (built before #27064 landed) had no such method, so under `packageId` the load threw and no rows (`a_account`) were drawn. Product code was correct.

Fix forward instead of a revert: main-red card #27095 → PR #27103, merged as `84e13701bd` at 2026-10-28T06:26Z. That fake (and the #27010 one, #27097) gains `withPreviewDrafts() { return this; }`; no test was skipped or loosened. On `84e13701`, Test UI 11/16 and 12/16 completed `success` (all 16 UI shards green in the queue build), so the anchor no longer reproduces. Closing as fixed. Queued PRs ejected as `inherited` rows only need re-queuing.
